tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Secretary of Agriculture, acting through the Administrator of the Farm Service Agency, shall carry out a national agriculture imagery program to annually acquire aerial imagery during agricultural growing seasons from the continental United States.

tree.heading: Data
tree.text: The aerial imagery acquired under this section shall—

children.text: consist of high resolution processed digital imagery;
be made available in a format that can be provided to Federal, State, and private sector entities;
be technologically compatible with geospatial information technology; and
be consistent with the standards established by the Federal Geographic Data Committee.

tree.heading: Supplemental satellite imagery
tree.text: The Secretary of Agriculture may supplement the aerial imagery collected under this section with satellite imagery.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There is authorized to be appropriated to carry out this section $23,000,000 for fiscal year 2019 and each fiscal year thereafter.
